Donington Park — circuit survey

id donington · European GP (1993, retired classic) · UK · theme green, night:false · base tree 681739c (survey branch cursor/donington-survey-a1, merges of shared-shot-tooling-5b45 and day-wet-lighting-b7b8 both applied) · read-only: no js/ or css/ edits.

Legend: MEASURED from the built centreline / audits / renders · SOURCE a claim in the brief or code comments · GUESS inference not verified.

Summary

  1. The Craner Curves are not in the geometry. MEASURED: a 503 m stretch (racing 0.286–0.412) has |k|<0.002 (R>500 m) everywhere and falls only 6.4 m. The lap's real fall (−25.9 m at 0.6175) is 0.50–0.62, on the other side of the park.
  2. Weather response is broken for overcast and fog by day: the sky stays the same saturated blue as dry; only wet/rain/storm grey the sky.
  3. Start/pit frame: the 108 m pit block a few metres off the road edge fills the frame-0 views (orbit and trackside show a wall).
  4. Foliage: stacked-cone crowns with ~22 % forced gold/rust (build-props.js:1729) against a "soft, damp, broadleaf" brief; ghost-translucent near-camera trees in wet/rain/storm.
  5. Scenery header claims "guard drops ZERO" and "Old Hairpin is the lowest point"; verify-track reports 139 tree drops and the elevation table puts the low point 21 m lower elsewhere.

Anchoring

Pit/S-F rows (blocks 2–3, :168-217) use sl(f) = (f + SL) % 1 with SL = 1 − def._sceneryShift so they follow the moved start line; everything else is authored-frame (corner rows use fracs measured against the original v0 origin). Result: Goddards (racing 0.04) sits ~165 m to its apex after the S/F line, so the grid is on the straight before the chicane, the pit block and Goddards sit side by side, and the real order (S/F after Goddards) is inverted GUESS on the real order.

Lamps, night, bridges, terrain

Furniture lamp:"none" and night:false → no lamp masts at all; dusk/night frames light the ground with generic pools and the car lights. The only bridge is the Starkey's kit deck (:402) with four wing-wall boxes (:414-417). Terrain: terrainOuter 110, elevation overridden by the SRTM table; the scenery's own terrainYAt seating is used for the Hollywood pad (:285) and Ratcliffe floor (:644).

Weather × time-of-day × lap position

Each row: racing fracs 0, 0.17, 0.33, 0.50, 0.67, 0.83. Orbit cam, TLX default renderer, SwiftShader, downscaled to 960 px (committed) / 720 px JPEG (here). Frame captions are lap fracs; filenames match artifacts/shots/tracks/donington/.

orbit · day · dry

Baseline. Saturated flat-blue sky (brief §2 asks for soft overcast); conifer-shaped crowns with ~22% gold/rust; frac 0 camera is boxed in by the 108 m pit-block wall.

orbit · day · wet

Sky goes dull violet-blue, tarmac darkens; foreground trees turn into translucent ghost shells (frames 0.33, 0.50, 0.83).

orbit · day · rain

Grey sky (PR #1979 works). Ghosted near-camera trees persist; distant tree layers lose crowns to dark masses.

orbit · day · overcast

Sky is IDENTICAL saturated blue to dry: overcast has no sky response (only keyMul/cloudCover in presets.js:7188). Also shows the grid at frac 0.17.

orbit · day · fog

Fog is a ground-hugging patchy mist only: sky stays full blue, trees fade to white ghost crowns. Reads as a bug, not English fog.

orbit · day · storm

Grey sky + rain streaks; heaviest darkening. Same ghosted foreground trees and terrain-flat horizon.

orbit · dusk · dry

Amber haze washes the whole scene yellow-olive; bright green light pools on the grass with no lamp source (lamp:'none').

orbit · dusk · rain

Better balance: wet road reflections, grey sky. Pools still float on grass.

orbit · night · dry

Black sky with a hard horizon cut; yellow-green pools lit around the car only. Circuit has night:false so no authored night scenery.

orbit · night · rain

Very dark; only car/pole pools and wet reflections. Most scenery invisible.

eye · day · dry

Eye-level. Pit/garage block and glass buildings read well at 0.00-0.17; Ratcliffe towers and airliner visible at 0.50. Dark pixel-grid band at the bottom of frame 0.00.

trackside · day · dry

Free-cam trackside. Frame 0.00 is entirely the pit wall; 0.17 shows dark stepped tyre stacks; large empty flat grass on the infield.

landmark frames · orbit · day · dry

Added after the lap-position grid missed the named corners.

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (none applied)

1 Craner Curves missing — 503 m near-straight

MEASURED racing 0.286–0.412, R>500 m, ΔY −6.4 m (y +1.6 → −4.7); orbit 0.33 and trackside 0.33 show a dead-straight road with no corner. Brief §3/§5 calls the Craner drop "the defining piece of terrain" and the corners "fast, blind, left-right". Mechanism: OSM trace smoothing in js/circuits/donington.js path.pts (two consecutive path points ~491 m apart: [125.6,−118.3]→[608.6,−28.5]) and 30 m SRTM in circuit-elevations.js:10. Fix: re-trace/author the bends with extra control points in the def (new-track), anchor corner rows by turn index, and let a hand elevation profile deepen the fall.

2 Elevation story contradicts the brief and comments

Scenery :374 and brief §3 say the Old Hairpin is the lowest point; measured Old Hairpin ≈ −4.8 m, low point −25.9 m at 0.6175 (Schwantz/McLeans). Starkey's Bridge (brief: "climb back out") sits mid-descent at y ≈ −18.7 (orbit 75). Fix: correct the brief/comments, or re-source the elevation.

3 Overcast/fog day show a clear-blue sky

Orbit day overcast and fog strips are visually identical to dry in the sky; day-wet is violet; rain/storm correctly grey. Dry day itself is hard blue vs brief §2. Mechanism: js/lighting/presets.js:7186-7190 (day dry only sunElev/shadowStr; overcast only keyMul/cloudCover .35/tint) and the sky path in js/lighting/atmosphere.js. Fix: raise cloudCover/sky desaturation for donington|day|dry/overcast/fog, or generically for fog/overcast (lighting-tuner). atmosphere mechanism not traced

4 Pit-block wall dominates frame 0

orbit00 and trackside00 (all weathers) show a blank wall, no car visible. Cause: building(K(sl(0.968)),1,15,14,6.5,108,…) (scenery:170) — 14 × 6.5 × 108 m flat block with placed at gap 15 m from the centreline (road half-width 7 m, so the face is within a few metres of the pit-lane edge). Fix: gap ≥ 26, or split into lower garage doors; keep orbit start framings in the survey set.

5 Foliage: cone crowns, forced autumn, guard-dropped trees

Crowns are the generic tree() (stacked cones) and plantTree turns 22 % to gold/rust (build-props.js:1729-1730); colour jitter (folVary :1718) overrides the file's muted LEAF palette (scenery:60-66). Header claims zero guard drops (:30-34) but verify-track suppresses 139 trees. Fix: engine option for a rounded broadleaf crown / no autumn on green furniture; update the comment.

6 Ghost/translucent trees and hedges in wet weather

Near-camera trees (orbit 0.33/0.50/0.83 wet, rain, storm) draw as see-through shells; Old Hairpin hedge (:378, with the terrace at :384 behind) is hollow with tan blocks visible. Likely the camera-clear fade/alpha path interacting with weather; mechanism unconfirmed — check with __apex.scene() batches.

7 Redgate dressing: dark stair-step stacks and a green block mound

Redgate (tyreWall :250, red TW_R) renders as near-black stepped stacks; inside the corner a lumpy mound of green boxes (hedge(0.034–0.078,+1,17) :234 + slopeRidge) intrudes on the apex. Fix: check tyreWall tint under the asset pack; end the hedge before 0.060.

8 Start line / Goddards order; side convention

S/F is ~165 m to its apex before Goddards (def comment :20-31 compromise); brief says "−1 is the outside": at Hollywood (left-hander) −1 is the inside, so the stand (:271) faces down the corner from the inside — plain cream box, not the cantilevered stand described.

9 Dusk/night lighting without lamps

Dusk-dry is a heavy amber haze; yellow-green pools float on the grass with no source (lamp "none"); night sky is pure black with a hard horizon, nothing beyond ~60 m. Expected for night:false but visible as defect in the preset (presets.js:7191-7210).

10 Corner radii: Melbourne "hairpin" R≈82 m; min node 8.9 m

Melbourne and Esses are broad bends (R 82/43); node 279 has R 8.9 m with half-width 7 (inner edge 1.9 m from the centre of curvature) — a geometry kink to look at, though surface folds = 0.
